title: FloodSQL-Bench: A Retrieval-Augmented Benchmark for Geospatially-Grounded Text-to-SQL
abstract: arXiv:2512.12084v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Existing Text-to-SQL benchmarks primarily focus on single-table queries or limited joins in general-purpose domains, and thus fail to reflect the complexity of domain-specific, multi-table and geospatial reasoning, To address this limitation, we introduce FLOODSQL-BENCH, a geospatially grounded benchmark for the flood management domain that integrates heterogeneous datasets through key-based, spatial, and hybrid joins. The benchmark captures realistic flood-related information needs by combining social, infrastructural, and hazard data layers. We systematically evaluate recent large language models with the same retrieval-augmented generation settings and measure their performance across difficulty tiers. By providing a unified, open benchmark grounded in real-world disaster management data, FLOODSQL-BENCH establishes a practical testbed for advancing Text-to-SQL research in high-stakes application domains.

translated_title: FloodSQL-Bench：一个面向地理空间定位Text-to-SQL的检索增强基准
translated_abstract: 现有的Text-to-SQL基准主要关注通用领域中的单表查询或有限的连接操作，因而无法反映特定领域、多表以及地理空间推理的复杂性。为解决这一局限，我们提出了FLOODSQL-BENCH，这是一个面向洪水管理领域的地理空间基准，通过基于键的连接、空间连接和混合连接来整合异构数据集。该基准通过结合社会、基础设施和灾害数据层，捕捉了现实的洪水相关信息需求。我们在相同的检索增强生成设置下系统评估了近期的多个大语言模型，并测量了它们在不同难度级别上的表现。通过提供一个基于真实灾害管理数据的统一开放基准，FLOODSQL-BENCH为推动高风险应用领域的Text-to-SQL研究建立了一个实用的测试平台。
tldr: 该论文提出了FLOODSQL-BENCH，一个面向洪水管理领域的地理空间Text-to-SQL检索增强基准，通过键、空间和混合连接整合异构数据集，为高风险应用领域中的Text-to-SQL研究建立了实用测试平台。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces FLOODSQL-BENCH, a retrieval-augmented geospatial Text-to-SQL benchmark for flood management that integrates heterogeneous datasets through key-based, spatial, and hybrid joins, establishing a practical testbed for advancing Text-to-SQL research in high-stakes application domains.
